REQ-1.description: Record the tech-stack decision (TypeScript, React, Vite, npm, pinned Node LTS) as an ADR under docs/adr/.

REQ-2.description: A buildable Vite + React + strict TypeScript app lives entirely under app/, with a pinned Node version, a committed lockfile, and npm scripts for dev, build, preview, typecheck, lint, format, format:check and test.

REQ-3.description: Formatter, linter, type checking and a unit test runner are configured and pass on the codebase; a smoke test renders the app.

REQ-4.description: Money handling rule: amounts are integer cents (never floats), with one shared module for parsing, formatting, arithmetic and deterministic rounding/allocation whose parts always sum exactly to the total; covered by unit tests.

REQ-5.description: App shell with client-side routing (Home placeholder plus Split, Finances, Settings placeholders and a not-found page), a responsive layout usable from 360px phone width to desktop, and a light/dark theme that follows the system with a manual override.

REQ-6.description: CI (GitHub Actions) runs install, typecheck, lint, format check, tests and production build for app/ on every push and pull request.

REQ-7.description: PWA-readiness groundwork: web app manifest, icons and viewport/theme-color meta; service worker explicitly deferred to M8. Developer README documents prerequisites and commands.
